maddeler.e:
أقتصر (form VIII)
# أَقْتَصِرُ (ʔaqtaṣiru) /ʔaq.ta.sˤi.ru/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِقْتَصَرَ (iqtaṣara)
# أُقْتَصَرُ (ʔuqtaṣaru) /ʔuq.ta.sˤa.ru/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِقْتَصَرَ (iqtaṣara)
# أَقْتَصِرَ (ʔaqtaṣira) /ʔaq.ta.sˤi.ra/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِقْتَصَرَ (iqtaṣara)
# أُقْتَصَرَ (ʔuqtaṣara) /ʔuq.ta
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
